verdict.rationale: Base44 documents an explicit eject/clone CLI command that downloads full frontend and backend code into a standalone project with its own app ID, plus GitHub sync for local development and an SDK/CLI for building outside the platform. This directly matches the story of exporting and running the app outside the platform, though hosting elsewhere isn't explicitly detailed beyond code export. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that ejected code runs fully standalone without Base44 backend dependencies, and explicit documentation of external hosting steps post-export.
